forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 32 of August, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Work completed included 1 zone survey and 2 visits; no technical surveys or clearances were completed. So far, 22 zones have been surveyed, 7 declared free, 22 areas released and 9 cleared. Mines have been found in 6 areas; 572 suspected or confirmed areas remain open.

Officer attention: 10 zones are closed according to the access feed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried. A new plan was approved this week: P08.

The week 32 forecast, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is already done, is 10 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 8 to 11 zones declared free this season (P10 to P90).
